subject: MedSys: post-call routing and contract sequencing

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Subject: Post-call recap: MedSys next steps & routing owners

Alex — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed routing/playbook so we can align internal teams and keep momentum: 

Key decision criteria you shared
- Accuracy of clinical summarization for discharge notes (priority)
- Sub-100ms median suggestion latency in the clinician UI
- On-prem/VPC option for PHI workloads in pilot
- Clear data retention & audit log controls

Stakeholder mapping (please confirm names/owners)
- Economic buyer: (you mentioned a finance sponsor) — who should we list as CFO/econ owner?
- Security/compliance: point of contact for SOC2 and data flow reviews
- Legal: primary reviewer for MSA/DPA redlines
- Procurement: PO/vendor onboarding owner (procurement@medsys.com?)

Recommended sequencing (our suggested minimal friction path)
1) NDA (mutual) — get confidentiality in place so we can share detailed architecture and logs
2) Vendor onboarding form / PO prerequisites — complete vendor registration in parallel
3) PoC SOW (technical scope & acceptance criteria) — short doc, signable
4) MSA + DPA redline (legal) — canonical doc for production terms

Target turn-times (we recommend): NDA: 3 business days, Onboarding/PO: 5 business days, MSA redline: 7–10 business days depending on complexity. Happy to tighten these if you have internal SLAs.

Next actions I can take today
- Send our standard mutual NDA to your legal (attached below)
- Share our one-pager on PoC scope and success criteria
- Pre-fill vendor onboarding fields we usually see requested (I'll attach our answers)

Attachments: medsys-moa-questions.xlsx (simple Q list for scope & success criteria)

If you can confirm the econ buyer and legal/procurement contacts (and preferred contract workflow — DocuSign vs email PDf redlines), we will route accordingly and loop our legal ops.

Thanks — looking forward to moving to NDA so we can start the tech deep dive.

—
